---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "feat: "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

Describe the problem this feature would solve. Focus on the problem, not just the solution.

## Proposed Solution

Describe what you would like to happen, in as much detail as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

List any alternative approaches you have considered.

## Who Would Benefit

- [ ] All users (Admin, HR, Employee)
- [ ] Admin only
- [ ] HR only
- [ ] Employee only
- [ ] Self-hosters / DevOps

## Additional Context

Links, mockups, or examples from other tools that illustrate what you have in mind.
